title: Remote Customer Support Representative - Travel & Booking Coordination
why_it_fits: Customer Service match. 2 skills: customer service, customer support. PH-eligible (Worldwide). Contract - matches IC status
key_responsibilities:
Assist clients with booking travel (flights, hotels, cruises, vacation packages)

Respond to customer inquiries via phone, email, and online platforms

Manage confirmations, itinerary updates, and travel documentation

Research destinations, pricing, and travel options

Maintain accurate client and booking records

Provide support before, during, and after travel
qualifications:
Strong communication and customer service skills

Self-motivated and comfortable working remotely

Detail-oriented and organized

Willingness to learn new systems and processes

Positive, solution-driven mindset

No prior travel experience required. Full training and ongoing support are provided.

 Eligibility 

Applicants must reside in countries where we are authorized to operate, including:

United States • United Kingdom • Australia • New Zealand • France • Germany • Spain • Italy • Netherlands • Ireland • Mexico • Colombia • Dominican Republic • Costa Rica • Brazil • Chile • Peru • Argentina • Jamaica • Bahamas • Barbados • Trinidad & Tobago • and select additional regions.

Applicants must also have reliable internet access and the ability to work remotely using a smart phone, computer or laptop.
what_we_offer:
& Benefits 

Flexible remote work environment

This is a 1099 independent contractor role, offering flexible hours and commission-based earning potential.

Typical monthly earnings range from $1,000 - $6,000+ based on activity level

Ongoing mentorship and professional development

Opportunities for advancement into leadership roles

Access to exclusive travel resources and industry discounts
application_process:
Submit your application through We Work Remotely

Selected candidates are invited to a virtual information session

Final onboarding discussion and training setup
